description: We are seeking a dedicated Social Worker to join our Children & Families team. The successful candidate will manage a caseload of vulnerable children and families, conduct assessments, build trusting relationships, coordinate multi-agency support, and advocate for service users. This is a demanding, emotionally engaged role suited to an empathetic graduate with strong interpersonal skills.
requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Social Work or a related discipline
Registration (or eligibility) with Social Work England
Strong assessment, safeguarding and case-management skills
Excellent interpersonal, empathy and relationship-building skills
Experience working with vulnerable children, families or communities
Ability to work within multi-agency safeguarding frameworks
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Resilience and the ability to manage emotionally demanding situations
